comment: Home Command Center PORTFOLIO tile stale decision, measured in COMPLETED US
equity trading sessions (weekdays minus NYSE full-closure holidays; a session
is complete once its 16:00 ET close, or 13:00 ET early close, has passed).
One completed session with no newer position observation is stale: a daily
broker sync that misses a trading day is worth surfacing. Over a weekend zero
sessions complete, so a Friday-after-close observation is FRESH on Monday
before the 09:07 ET sync instead of tripping the 48 wall-clock-hour rule.
This threshold lives here, not in code. coverage.stale_after_hours and
position_observation_oldest_age_hours keep their existing meaning for every
other consumer; the session fields are additive.
